channel.title: AI Decoded
channel.desc: AI Decoded features Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics lab where researchers use artificial intelligence to enable robots to perceive, plan, think, use tools and act to better solve complex, multi-step tasks. For reaction the AI Decoded team are joined by leading AI expert and Cognitive Scientist Gary Marcus to discuss what the future holds if humans are to exist alongside super intelligent machines.
